reviews.title: Some good ideas mixed with a whole lot of terrible people.
reviews.text:
This app can either find you genuinely good people or the worst kind, there's no in between. 

Good parts: 
Pic privacy is good with no screenshots or recordings so it's relatively comforting to be a bit more open. 

Not trying to be hinge.

You can go through people you've passed on / liked and change your mind (no paywall)

Bad parts:
When someone disconnects with you, their profile disappears. This gives massive power to abusers/manipulators who may give you a sense of comfort to get you to into a vulnerable spot (even if up to the point of abuse they didn't show red flags) then can cover their tracks by removing their existence from your side. You can't find them and you have no way to report them for their behaviour. I'm honestly worried for others out there who could be caught in the same sitch. 

Radius is limited so you can get liked and yet run out of people and never those likes unless you pay. 

Wayyy too many bot/fake accounts.

In over 4 years using this app I've interacted with 3 people beyond this app.  

Way too many perverts and weirdos filling this space.

reviews.title: Boost And Contact
reviews.text:
I’m disappointed with the VIP experience, especially considering the app costs $40. VIP supposedly includes the ability to boost your account and send pokes, but I’m still being charged for every single poke. I also cannot find anywhere in the app to actually use the account boost feature.

There is a Frequently Asked Questions section, but there doesn’t appear to be any clear way to contact customer support when you have an issue or question.

For a $40 app, I would expect the VIP features to be clearly explained, easily accessible, and actually included without additional charges. The lack of transparency and customer support really needs to be addressed.

reviews.title: Don’t pay for this scam
reviews.text:
Starting with their subtitle here, “bisexual, lesbian…”. Incredibly misleading. My account was banned after being a paid member in the past with this cute little email:
“ due to multiple reports from our members. And we do not allow any type of commercial behavior, i.e. anything related to money on our app. Your account won't be available anymore.

We 100% do not condone fake profiles on our app. We have a dedicated team that works diligently to remove anyone misusing our platform

Regards,

Dana”
=============

Except that never happened. Anyone can report anyone on any of these apps. My profile was not only not fake, I wrote a thoughtful bio that clearly showed that my partner and I were very intentional and considerate of everyone’s time while trying to connect with others. After being catfished and scammed by picture collectors in fake profiles (I suspect created by the app staff themselves) all along the couple of years I’ve used this stupid app, I finally posted (paraphrasing) “if all you want is pictures, without even sharing your own, just search for us on OnlyFans”. And this is the customer service template email response we got. 

We never met or connected in person with ANYONE off this app after using it and chatting with folks for years. It’s all been a scam and a big waste of time.

reviews.title: Wrongfully banned for LOOKING young
reviews.text:
The people who run things or the AI system that is used for this app is absolutely terrible. I look a bit young, I know that. I had to verify myself once before and willingly did so. No problem, I do it for other adult apps. A few days ago I moved another picture to the main slot and for some reason lost my verification. No big deal.

Until it was a big deal! I wanted to update my pictures and got banned for it! The reason? I’m underage?! I’m an adult and have been for years. It is absolutely ridiculous and disgraceful that this app banned me for looking young when they should already have my id in the system. It’s almost discriminatory.

Then when I write an email explicitly explaining the issue I get an email back calling me a liar and a minor? Telling me to send proof when they already have it? What more do you need? A lie detector test? My hand on a bible?!

Completely unacceptable and unprofessional on the developer and the verification team’s part. Either fix the computer that runs the verification or get people who do their job properly.

I don’t even want to use the app anymore I just want to get in contact with the people I connected with and say goodbye to this thing.
